# Cattalus — the lines (generated by Tools/Voice/make_cattalus_lines.py from Docs/CHAPTER_CATTALUS.md)

Voices: 7 = Seven (Eleven v3, performance notes as audio tags) · Panther = Cat · Juniper = Dan's saved "juniper" · Duchess = Dan's saved "Duchess" · Steward = Dan's saved "steward" · the Announcer (+ every Cat-a-tron advert) = "TeedOff Barker" from Tee'd Off (Eleven v3). Cats are telepathic in Unity; the announcer is the square's PA (`Tools/Voice/generate_cattalus_voices.py`). Files: `Unity/Assets/Resources/CattalusVoice/<id>.mp3`. `_P` / `_CALL` ids = Code's proposed lines (Dan to review).
